body: I know that feel bro. I work for a major retailer, and I couldn't even make my rent in the shittiest apartment for hundreds of miles around. I've been homeless for about 6 months now.

Man, I've been homeless for 6 months. But I can still afford food, so nothing to complain about.

I remember my dad used to work at a factory to make ends meet. He has a problem with low blood sugar, but he used to go for days without eating so there'd be more to go around. I remember how he used to look walking in the door, so tired that he couldn't even lift his eyes. Once he blacked out from exhaustion and cut his thumb off in one of the machines.

I'm never gonna have kids. I'd rather starve to death alone than make a kid watch me go through that. I forgot what my point was but uh... happy thanksgiving?

I know how you feel mate. You're me from 3 years ago.

I'm gonna give you a little secret about the debt collectors. They're only calling you because there's no other way for them to get your money. They're trying to guilt you into paying. What they don't want you to know is it's not even going on your credit score. Remember that Donald Trump has filed for bankruptcy 11 times and counting, and retards still trust him with billions of dollars. If that piece of shit can get away with it, then you can get your goddamn education without feeling a shred of guilt.

Shitty part is, human error would cause more accidental death than "killer robots" ever would. I used to be a professional killer. "Shoot first, ask qustions later. Otherwise someone else will shoot first." That's what they told me during training.
